mapper.select: SELECT SUBSTRING_INDEX(s.industry, '-', 1) AS industry, COUNT(*) AS stockCount, ROUND(AVG(eff.eff_cp), 4) AS avgChangePct, SUM(CASE WHEN eff.eff_cp > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS upCount, SUM(CASE WHEN eff.eff_cp < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS downCount, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN eff.eff_cp > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 1) AS upRatio FROM ( SELECT d.stock_code, CASE WHEN d.change_percent IS NOT NULL AND d.change_percent != 0 THEN d.change_percent ELSE ROUND((d.close_price - COALESCE(y.close_price, d.pre_close, 0)) / GREATEST(COALESCE(y.close_price, d.pre_close, 0.01), 0.01) * 100, 4) END AS eff_cp FROM stock_daily d LEFT JOIN stock_daily y ON d.stock_code = y.stock_code AND y.trade_date = DATE_SUB(d.trade_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY) WHERE d.trade_date = #{tradeDate} AND d.close_price IS NOT NULL ) eff JOIN stock s ON eff.stock_code = s.stock_code WHERE s.industry IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(s.industry) != '' GROUP BY SUBSTRING_INDEX(s.industry, '-', 1) ORDER BY avgChangePct DESC

SELECT SUBSTRING_INDEX(s.industry, '-', 1) AS topIndustry, s.stock_code AS stockCode, s.stock_name AS stockName, CASE WHEN d.change_percent IS NOT NULL AND d.change_percent != 0 THEN d.change_percent ELSE ROUND((d.close_price - COALESCE(y.close_price, d.pre_close, 0)) / GREATEST(COALESCE(y.close_price, d.pre_close, 0.01), 0.01) * 100, 4) END AS changePercent FROM stock_daily d JOIN stock s ON d.stock_code = s.stock_code LEFT JOIN stock_daily y ON d.stock_code = y.stock_code AND y.trade_date = DATE_SUB(d.trade_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY) WHERE d.trade_date = #{tradeDate} AND s.industry IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(s.industry) != '' AND d.close_price IS NOT NULL ORDER BY topIndustry, changePercent DESC

SELECT d.trade_date AS tradeDate, ROUND(AVG(d.open_price), 2) AS openPrice, ROUND(MAX(d.high_price), 2) AS highPrice, ROUND(MIN(d.low_price), 2) AS lowPrice, ROUND(AVG(d.close_price), 2) AS closePrice, SUM(d.volume) AS volume, SUM(d.amount) AS amount FROM stock_daily d JOIN stock s ON d.stock_code = s.stock_code WHERE s.industry LIKE CONCAT(#{industry}, '%') AND d.trade_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) GROUP BY d.trade_date ORDER BY d.trade_date ASC

SELECT eff.stock_code AS stockCode, s.stock_name AS stockName, s.market, s.industry, s.pe AS pe, eff.close_price AS price, eff.eff_cp AS changePct, ROUND(eff.close_price - eff.pre_close_val, 2) AS `change`, eff.volume, eff.high_price AS highPrice, eff.low_price AS lowPrice, eff.turnover_rate AS turnoverRate FROM ( SELECT d.stock_code, d.close_price, d.volume, d.high_price, d.low_price, d.turnover_rate, d.pre_close AS pre_close_val, CASE WHEN d.change_percent IS NOT NULL AND d.change_percent != 0 THEN d.change_percent ELSE ROUND((d.close_price - COALESCE(y.close_price, d.pre_close, 0)) / GREATEST(COALESCE(y.close_price, d.pre_close, 0.01), 0.01) * 100, 4) END AS eff_cp FROM stock_daily d LEFT JOIN stock_daily y ON d.stock_code = y.stock_code AND y.trade_date = DATE_SUB(d.trade_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY) WHERE d.trade_date = (SELECT MAX(trade_date) FROM stock_daily) ) eff RIGHT JOIN stock s ON eff.stock_code = s.stock_code
AND (s.stock_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR s.stock_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND s.industry LIKE CONCAT(#{industry}, '%')
AND (s.stock_code LIKE '600%' OR s.stock_code LIKE '601%' OR s.stock_code LIKE '603%' OR s.stock_code LIKE '605%' OR s.stock_code LIKE '000%' OR s.stock_code LIKE '001%' OR s.stock_code LIKE '002%' OR s.stock_code LIKE '003%')
AND (s.stock_code LIKE '600%' OR s.stock_code LIKE '601%' OR s.stock_code LIKE '603%' OR s.stock_code LIKE '605%')
AND (s.stock_code LIKE '000%' OR s.stock_code LIKE '001%' OR s.stock_code LIKE '002%' OR s.stock_code LIKE '003%')
AND s.stock_code LIKE '688%'
AND s.stock_code LIKE '300%'
AND (s.stock_code LIKE '83%' OR s.stock_code LIKE '43%' OR s.stock_code LIKE '87%')
AND s.market = #{market}
ORDER BY eff.close_price ASC
ORDER BY eff.close_price DESC
ORDER BY eff.eff_cp ASC
ORDER BY eff.eff_cp DESC
ORDER BY eff.volume ASC
ORDER BY eff.volume DESC
ORDER BY eff.eff_cp DESC
LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
